standard_prerequisites.name: An etale morphism is flat, and flatness is preserved by composition
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-etale-flat (proof line 139); Algebra, label algebra-lemma-composition-flat (proof line 141)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the easy implication from flatness over the etale scheme to flatness over the base.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change of a flat module, and the diagonal of an etale morphism is an open immersion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, labels morphisms-lemma-base-change-module-flat (proof line 147), morphisms-lemma-diagonal-unramified-morphism and morphisms-lemma-etale-smooth-unramified (proof lines 150-151)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first makes the pullback of the module to the product flat over the etale scheme, and the others identify the source with an open subscheme of the product on which the restriction of the second projection is the given morphism.

core_obligations: Get the easy implication: since an etale morphism is flat, flatness over the etale scheme implies flatness over the base by composition (proof lines 137-141).

Transport the module to the product: assume flatness over the base at the point, let the lifted point of the product be the one over the given points, and use base change of flat modules to see that the pullback of the module to the product is flat over the etale scheme (proof lines 142-147).

Conclude by the diagonal: the diagonal of the etale morphism is an open immersion, so the source is an open subscheme of the product on which the restriction of the second projection is the given morphism and the pulled back module restricts to the original one, whence flatness over the etale scheme (proof lines 148-156).
proof_roadmap: Easy implication from flatness of the etale morphism (proof lines 137-141).
Base change makes the pullback flat over the etale scheme (proof lines 142-147).
Diagonal open immersion identifies the source inside the product (proof lines 148-156).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that flatness of a module over the base is equivalent to flatness over an etale cover, pointwise and globally (statement lines 123-135, tag 05FQ-adjacent). One implication is composition with the flat etale morphism, while the converse uses that the pullback of the module to the product is flat over the etale scheme by base change and that the diagonal of an etale morphism is an open immersion, which identifies the source inside the product so that the given morphism becomes the restriction of the projection. The diagonal argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
